narrative: During maintenance on Workover Rig WOR-07 wellhead, the master valve was not properly isolated and residual pressure of 45 psi remained in the line while workers were present in the cellar without zero-energy verification.
Technician began loosening bolts on pump discharge spool without opening vent bleeder valve. Trapped hydraulic pressure released abruptly, splashing oil across the deck.
During pig receiver door opening, secondary bleed valve was clogged with wax deposits. Operator noticed pressure gauge registered 15 psi residual gas behind door hinge before latch disengagement.
Work crew unbolted flange on condensate transfer line assuming system was depressurized. Residual condensate spray ejected through gasket gap when lower studs were backed off.
Lockout tagout padlock was removed by an unauthorized subcontractor before mechanical technician had completed packing replacement on mud pump manifold.
Single block valve isolation used on 800 psi gas transmission line instead of positive blind spade or double-block-and-bleed during valve seat replacement.
Accumulator hydraulic circuit retained 120 bar pressure after pump shutdown due to jammed non-return check valve. Mechanic noticed gauge reading before disassembling control line.
Contractor technician attempted to drain lubricating oil reservoir without verifying zero air pressure in the pneumatic agitation circuit.
Air receiver tank drain valve was stiff and unserviced, leaving pneumatic line partially pressurized during filter screen replacement.
Mechanic unscrewed hydraulic hose fitting without bleeding down pressure using manual relief screw, causing minor spray on boot.
Technician working at 22 meters elevation on monkey board platform without dual safety harness lanyard 100% tie-off during sudden squall winds.
Scaffolding toe-board and mid-rail were missing along the edge of rig sub-structure platform 8 meters above ground level near pipe rack.
Derrickman unhooked inertia reel lanyard while leaning across tubing fingers to guide drill collar string without secondary safety line anchor.
Open grating hatch on second level separation deck left uncovered and without red safety barricade tape while electrical conduit was routed below.
Painter slipped on grease-stained gangway step at 5 meters height and caught himself on handrail; harness was unfastened from lifeline cable.
Rigger stepped onto temporary wooden scaffolding plank that was not tied down; plank tilted under load but rigger regained footing on main steel beam.
Contractor ladder placed on oily concrete floor without non-slip rubber feet or top tie-off while inspecting valve position 3 meters up.
Worker climbed step stool instead of certified fiberglass stepladder to reach overhead pressure gauge in compressor shelter.
Ladder rung missing top safety gate chain on access tower to water storage tank roof at 4 meters elevation.
Floor grating clamp loose on walkway adjacent to mud shale shaker; grating shifted 2 inches when roustabout walked over it.
Flange gasket failure on crude gas separator V-201 outlet line resulted in high-volume combustible methane gas release with LEL exceeding 40% in battery area.
Strong gas odor detected downwind of gas booster compressor C-2; field operator confirmed packing seal blowout with portable detector reading 65% LEL.
During well circulation, mud gas separator vent line backpressured causing relief valve to lift and vent hydrocarbon gas at ground level near generators.
Instrument gas tubing snapped at fitting due to compressor skid vibration, spraying wet natural gas continuously into enclosed engine shed.
Corrosion pinhole detected on 4-inch flowline weld neck joint; natural gas bubbling observed through standing rainwater pool near perimeter fence.
Operator left manual drain valve on knock-out drum cracked open while answering radio call; condensate and gas vented to open ditch for 6 minutes.
Sampling point needle valve gland nut leaking minor droplets of light hydrocarbon liquid with localized 8% LEL reading on sniffer wand.
Faint gas scent noticed around meter skid orifice plate flange; soapy water bubble test revealed tiny weep at bottom stud.
Temporary vent hose from lab sample cylinder discharge not clamped to flare header, venting small trace gas into open air.
Crude oil transfer pump mechanical seal dripping approximately 15 drops per minute of volatile oil into catch pan.
Sour crude well testing operation encountered unexpected H2S spike of 75 ppm in cellar area; fixed beacon alarm activated but two crew members had personal monitors switched off.
Personal multi-gas monitor alarmed at 18 ppm H2S when operator cracked thief hatch on sour condensate storage tank without wearing 30-minute SCBA breathing apparatus.
Fixed H2S sensor on drilling mud flowline shaker showed fault code and was bypassed by electrician instead of immediate recalibration during sour zone penetration.
Pungent rotten-egg odor reported near produced water skimming pit; portable sensor confirmed 12 ppm H2S plume shifting toward muster point due to wind change.
Emergency escape breathing apparatus (EEBA) cylinders stored in rig doghouse had inspection tags expired by 4 months with pressure gauges below green zone.
Windsock at wellsite perimeter was torn and tangled, preventing crew from determining upwind escape route during sour gas flaring.
Contractor entered designated sour crude well pad without checking in with HSE kiosk or collecting personal calibrated H2S clip monitor.
Gas detector bump-test station calibration gas cylinder was empty, delaying morning crew sensor verification by 45 minutes.
Signboard indicating 'Danger: Possible Sour Gas H2S Area' was faded and obscured by overgrown vegetation along access road.
During well kill pumping operations at 3200 psi, high-pressure Chiksan iron union cracked and ejected fluid jet that severed electrical conduit 3 meters away.
High-pressure mud pump discharge pulsation dampener bladder ruptured during drilling, generating violent pipe shock that tore hanger bracket from I-beam.
Whipcheck safety sling cables were missing on 2500 psi water injection flexible rotary hose connected between manifold and wellhead tree.
Technician passed within 2 feet of unbarricaded 5000 psi hydrostatic pressure test line while test pump was stroking up to target pressure.
Hydraulic torque wrench hose developed pinhole high-pressure oil leak that atomized into mist adjacent to operator holding reaction arm.
Needle valve stem backed out under 1800 psi gas pressure when operator attempted to open it with excessive force using pipe wrench.
Hydro-test pressure warning barricade red tape had fallen to ground in pipe yard, allowing forklift driver to enter test exclusion zone.
Pressure test chart recorder pen ran out of ink during 10-minute hold period on 6-inch spool pressure test.
Washdown water hose nozzle quick-connect fitting worn, disconnected under 60 psi water pressure splashing operator overalls.
A 14-inch heavy steel pipe wrench fell 18 meters from derrick mast monkey board, crashing onto rig floor 4 feet from driller console.
Crane auxiliary hook wire rope snapped during transfer of 2.4-ton drill collar bundle, causing load to drop 6 meters into pipe catwalk.
Rigger observed uncertified synthetic lifting sling with severe cut across 40% of webbing being attached to heavy motor skid.
Overhead floodlight fixture bracket corroded and hung by single loose bolt directly above main walkway on derrick substructure.
Roustabout walked directly beneath suspended 1500 kg chemical tote being hoisted by mobile crane without paying attention to whistle signals.
Safety cotter pin was missing from 8.5-ton shackle bolt pin on crane spreader bar prior to picking up blowout preventer stack.
Scaffolders passed steel coupling tubes by hand overhead across 3 levels without tethering tools or using canvas hoist buckets.
Small 10mm bolt dropped from 2-meter ladder step while electrician was mounting junction box cover; landed on deck without impact.
Tagline attached to lifted crate was frayed at trailing end and dragging on ground.
Roughneck positioned legs inside loop of high-tension hydraulic cathead snatch line while breaking out drill pipe joint on rotary table.
Rotary table master bushing safety perimeter interlock guard was removed while drive shaft was rotating at 90 rpm during coring operations.
Winch wire rope jumped off sheave drum flange and whipped across walkway under 12-ton pull tension; roustabout had cleared area seconds earlier.
Excavator operator swung bucket toward trench edge without spotting marshal, forcing pipeline welder to jump out of swing radius.
Forklift reversing alarm was disabled and backup camera shattered while driver moved steel tubular crates through congested warehouse yard.
Maintenance mechanic adjusted belt tension on active air compressor motor without isolating electrical breaker or applying lockout tag.
High-visibility vest not worn by contractor guiding backhoe loader through muddy field pipeline right-of-way in twilight.
Safety guard on bench grinder in workshop had loose bolt and shook during tool sharpening.
Cleaning crew entered 3-phase crude separator vessel V-201 without continuous multi-gas atmospheric testing and safety sentry was absent from manhole.
Nitrogen purge line remained connected to storage tank manway during internal inspection; oxygen concentration inside dropped to 14.2%.
Contractor entered muddy cellar sump pit 3 meters deep without confined space entry permit, ventilation blower, or gas test verification.
Confined space ventilation fan ducting became crimped shut by heavy toolbox, cutting off fresh air delivery to welders inside oil tank.
Entry attendant left station outside water separator tank to fetch drinking water while two workers remained working inside.
Confined space entry permit gas test values recorded at 07:00 were re-used for afternoon entry without performing new atmospheric check.
Tripod rescue winch harness at confined space vessel hatch had unspooled wire kinked across guide pulley.
Exhaust hose on portable diesel generator routed too close to air intake of compressor building workshop window.
Contractor commenced oxy-acetylene torch cutting on pipe support bracket inside Zone 1 gas processing area without hot work permit or continuous gas monitoring.
Non-explosion-proof electrical halogen floodlamp plugged into standard domestic extension cord positioned 2 meters from active condensate drain sump.
Sparks from angle grinding on walkway handrail showered over open drain funnel; safety fire blanket was absent and fire watch had stepped away.

During burner lighting on crude unit vacuum furnace F-101, fuel gas accumulated in combustion firebox due to passing pilot valve; attempt to ignite burner resulted in violent deflagration and furnace door blowout.
Refinery process fired heater tube ruptured during high-fire operation, releasing pressurized hydrocarbon stream that ignited on furnace refractory wall creating catastrophic fireball.
Operators attempted manual relight of crude heating furnace pilot without performing mandatory 15-minute steam purge following burner flameout.
CSB process safety investigation identified that fuel gas burner safety shutoff interlock was bypassed on fired reboiler, leading to unburned gas buildup in furnace firebox.
Flame rollout observed from furnace burner inspection port due to positive firebox draft pressure caused by fouled air preheater damper.
Severe fuel gas header leak inside process furnace burner enclosure caused explosive gas cloud detection with LEL sensors exceeding 80%.
Driver entered classified oil tanker loading gantry with personal non-intrinsically safe smartphone active in hand during fuel transfer.
Flame arrestor mesh on diesel generator engine exhaust stack found heavily corroded with 2-inch tear allowing unquenched exhaust sparks.
Static grounding clamp cable disconnected from road tanker truck during crude transfer operation into storage vessel.
Fire extinguisher dry chemical gauge needle in red discharge zone at welding station hot work perimeter.
Temporary electrical cables on ground near wash pad lacked rubber bridge protector ramps.
Severe soil erosion after monsoon flash floods washed away soil beneath rig sub-base corner pad, causing 4-degree mast tilt during drill string pull.
Sub-structure structural diagonal bracing pin was found sheared with hairline fracture along lower gusset plate under active mast vibration.
Scaffolding tower standing 12 meters high swayed violently in crosswinds because wall tie anchors had been removed by insulation contractors.
Heavy corrosion pitting found on structural steel legs of elevated chemical storage tank platform with metal thickness reduced by 35%.
Rig leveling hydraulic outrigger cylinder leaked fluid overnight, resulting in 2-inch foundation settling under pipe rack loading.
Wooden timber matting beneath mobile crane outrigger cracked and split under load on soft ground during pump hoist.
Pipe rack stanchion safety stop pin bent, allowing single joint of casing to roll 1 foot down rack rack skid before stopping.
Handrail base flange bolts loose on staircase leading to separator gantry platform.
Derrickman observed ascending mast ladder without inertia reel fall arrestor attached to harness D-ring.
Temporary grating opening around wellhead cellar covered only with loose cardboard sheet.
Worker stepped backwards toward unprotected cellar edge 2.5 meters deep; caught by coworker arm.
Scaffold inspection green tag missing on access tower; crew climbed scaffolding to paint valve manifold.
Full body harness leg strap unbuckled while operator worked on pipe rack platform 4 meters high.
Guardrail chain unhooked at top of mud tank stairway 3 meters above ground.
Grease patch on staircase tread caused operator to slip, holding onto handrail.
Maintenance lead unthreaded needle valve on 1200 psi gas line; threads stripped due to trapped pressure.
Isolation lock applied to wrong bypass valve while main separator line remained energized at 35 bar.
Flange bolts cracked open on pressurized diesel transfer line without using drip tray or deflector shield.
Mechanical spring on blowout preventer closing actuator released violently during bench overhaul.
LOTO tag faded and illegible on main 415V electrical breaker switchboard.
Air bleed valve on pneumatic control cabinet left closed prior to filter element change.
Pressure gauge needle pinned at zero due to internal sediment blockage while line held 20 psi.
Corrosion rupture on 8-inch crude pipeline section released vapor cloud across oil gathering station.
Gas compressor suction scrubber high level trip switch failed, allowing raw condensate into cylinder.
Gas alarm siren at oil collecting station went uninvestigated for 15 minutes during evening changeover.
Flange leak on condensate stabilization column sprayed mist 4 meters into process pipe alley.
Vent header drain plug corroded through, weeping gas condensate droplets onto concrete plinth.
Operator forgot to close manual bleeder on gas scrubber level bridle after daily blowdown.
Smell of hydrocarbon gas near pump packing seal; soap test showed small bubbles.
High H2S concentration of 45 ppm detected at shale shaker during coring; mud engineer not wearing breathing kit.
Fixed toxic gas detector sensor head obstructed by mud splash and plastic tape.
Technician opened sample cock on sour water line without checking local wind direction windsock.
H2S alarm triggered at 15 ppm during drill stem test; roustabout donned SCBA mask promptly.
SCBA air cylinder pressure verified at 120 bar instead of mandatory 200 bar ready charge.
Personal H2S detector battery low beeper ignored for 2 hours during well logging.
Spare breathing apparatus cylinder valve cap missing, allowing dust into regulator port.
Choke manifold valve body washed out under 4500 psi sand flow, cutting through steel flange lip.
High-pressure test plug ejected from pipe spool during 3000 psi test, penetrating wooden bulkhead.
Flexible hydraulic line rubbed against rotating top drive torque guide until steel braid frayed.
Pin-hole water jet from 2000 psi washdown pump grazed worker rubber glove without breaking skin.
Hammer union connection on cement pump discharge line struck with sledgehammer while under pressure.
Pressure gauge snubber damper valve stuck shut, preventing true pressure reading during surge.
Hydraulic oil weep at fitting nut on power tong arm dripping onto driller console floor.
Sledgehammer left on top derrick crown block platform after sheaves grease servicing.
Tugger winch cable snapped while dragging 800 kg BOP component across cellar, striking handrail.
Rig worker walked under 3-ton casing joint being lifted by crane into V-door without looking up.
Webbing sling pinched against sharp steel edge of separator skid during offloading without softeners.
Chain hoist latch spring broken on overhead monorail beam in pump house.
Heavy crescent wrench slipped out of back pocket while climbing mast ladder; caught in ladder safety cage.
Empty wooden pallet fell off forklift tines from 1 foot height; no personnel nearby.
Technician leaned over revolving mud pump crosshead guide to inspect oil level while pump was running.
Wireline cable caught on lubricator tree valve and reached extreme tension before winch was halted.
Snubbing line anchor turnbuckle threads stripped under high wellhead pull force, snapping cable back.
Forklift moved in reverse into tight pipe alley while spotter was looking in opposite direction.
Loose clothing sleeve caught on power tong guide handle during drill string rotation.
Drive coupling yellow perimeter mesh guard unbolted and resting on floor beside running generator.
Worker stood within 1 meter of taut rope while truck was pulled out of mud hole.
Welders entered unventilated pontoon ballast compartment without gas test or rescue tripod rig.
Nitrogen gas cylinder leaked inside closed tool van overnight; oxygen meter alarmed at 15.5%.
Excavation trench dug to 2.4 meters depth in contaminated ground entered without air sampling or shoring.
Exhaust fumes from suction vacuum truck sucked into air inlet of workers' breathing air compressor.
Confined space warning barricade sign knocked down outside oil tank manway opening.
Gas test instrument calibration certificate expired by two weeks; still used for vessel entry signoff.
Ventilation blower air hose partially kinked under wooden block, reducing airflow to pit by 25%.
Technician used non-intrinsically safe battery power drill inside closed gas manifold compressor room.
Lightning strike earth bonding strap severed on high crude oil storage tank T-102.
Hot work permit issued for welding on pipe rack without verifying that nearby open drain was sealed.
Sparks flew toward open hydrocarbon sample bucket during grinding of flange stud; fire watch stopped work.
Explosion-proof junction box cover missing 4 out of 8 certified stainless steel screws in Zone 1 area.
Diesel engine air intake emergency shutoff flapper valve failed to trip during overspeed safety test.
Smoking observed near waste chemical drum storage area 20 meters outside designated smoking shelter.
Severe vibration on drilling mast caused top guide roller bolt to shear off during heavy casing run.
Derrick guy wire tension below manufacturer specifications by 50% during impending gale storm.
Crack observed along weld seam of main crane pedestal turntable mounting flange during pre-lift check.
Mud tank walkway steel support leg rusted through with 50% section loss under chemical load.
Forklift mast tilted forward on uneven gravel yard while carrying maximum rated steel spool load.
Rig substructure leveling jack hydraulic seal weeping oil under dead weight of drill collars.
Loose bolts on engine generator skid mounting foundation causing noticeable skid shift.
